This modern storage shelf combines a sturdy iron frame with MDF panels, featuring a 2/3-tier open design and unique wave-slot detailing to keep items securely in place while reducing clutter. Available in milk tea, black, and green finishes, it fits perfectly on desks, bedside areas, or window sills in bedrooms and home offices.

Designed for multi-purpose organization, this compact yet stylish shelf offers practical storage with a contemporary aesthetic, ideal for books, décor, and everyday essentials.
